sections.section_title: ADC analog watchdog 1 lower threshold register (ADC_AWD1LTR)
sections.text_helper: Section 21.6.21 "ADC analog watchdog 1 lower threshold register (ADC_AWD1LTR)" in chapter 21 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 659.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0A8
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:23 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 22:0 LTR[22:0]: Analog watchdog 1 lower threshold
These bits are set and cleared by software to define the lower threshold for analog watchdog 1.
Refer to Section21.4.27: Analog window watchdog (AWD1EN, JAWD1EN, AWD1SGL, AWD1CH,
AWDCH of ADC_AWD2CR and ADC_AWD3CR, HTR, LTR, AWDFILT).
